home.tagline: Builder from Taiwan. Software engineer by trade.
home.about1: I'm drawn to hard technical problems and engineering best practices: the golden paths that make good engineering the easy default. This site is where I write down what I learn.
home.about2: Off-screen I'm usually hiking, camping, or on a tennis court. I also map the places I visit as a Google Maps Local Guide. Researching and diving deep into a problem is what keeps me calm and recharges me. Fellow Trojan.
